description: This is a test class for the EmployeeImmigrationRecordService in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employee immigration records, verifying the behavior of the service layer using mock objects.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeImmigrationRecordService functionalities, including CRUD operations and searches.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of EmployeeImmigrationRecordService and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of employee immigration records for a specific employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single employee immigration record by employee and record ID.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Tests saving an EmployeeImmigrationRecord object and validates saved properties.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple immigration records for an employee.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Tests searching for immigration records using search filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of immigration records matching search criteria.
